Required Fields on a New Department

User manual · English · 6 steps
Learn what happens when you save a department without a name.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Departments

Click Departments.

3. New

Click New to start a department.

4. Save

Click the save icon without filling anything in.

5. Read the message

Read the red message. Click it to continue.

6. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
